title: Modular Power on Encoded Inputs
statement: For natural numbers $a,n,p$ with $p\neq 0$, encode the binary representations of $a$, $n$, and $p$ as the nested pair $\langle\operatorname{bits}(a),\langle\operatorname{bits}(n),\operatorname{bits}(p)\rangle\rangle$. The binary output of the encoded modular-power operation on this input is $\operatorname{bits}(a^n\bmod p)$.
hypotheses_covered: a, n, and p are natural numbers
